milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia tree is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 7). max_distance=3 prevents premature triggering since tree is 7 blocks from spawn. Player must walk forward and be within 3 blocks while facing the tree trunk to confirm intentional discovery.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. White wool is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 9) on the display shelf. Player must navigate past the acacia tree and turn right to reach the wool display area within 4 blocks while facing it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Red wool is at spawn-relative (6, 1, 9), directly adjacent to white wool. Player is already nearby after finding white wool; facing_tolerance ensures intentional observation of the red wool block specifically.

Uses inventory_has because the chest at (-7,1,9) contains 8 glass blocks which are the ONLY source of plain glass in the entire scene. The player starts with no glass, so having glass in inventory proves the chest was actually opened and looted — more reliable than proximity-only checks for interaction tasks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. TNT is at spawn-relative (-8, 1, 9), adjacent to the chest inside the workshop. max_distance=4 requires being inside the workshop building and facing the TNT block to confirm discovery.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because mining/breaking a block means it no longer exists at its location. Two black_stained_glass blocks are at (-9,2,7) and (-9,2,8) on the workshop's west wall. max_count=1 means at least one was broken. Box generously encompasses both blocks with margin.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because mining the potted plant removes the block from the world. Potted blue orchid is at spawn-relative (7, 2, 9) on an elevated shelf near the wool display. max_count=0 confirms the block was completely removed. Mining drops a flower pot and blue orchid item.

Uses inventory_has because crafting light_blue_stained_glass results in the item appearing in inventory. Two-step process: (1) craft blue_orchid into light_blue_dye in inventory grid, (2) combine 8 glass + 1 light_blue_dye in crafting table. Player starts with none of this item, so min_count=1 confirms successful crafting. Recipe hint sign provided on workshop wall.

scene_description: A compact outpost with an acacia tree ahead of spawn (z=7), a wool display with potted blue orchid to the right (x=5-7, z=9), and a stone brick workshop to the left (x=-9 to -4, z=5-10). The workshop contains a chest with 8 plain glass, black stained glass windows on the west wall, TNT next to the chest, a crafting table, and a recipe hint sign on the back wall. Player receives a regular diamond pickaxe. Two parallel task branches converge at the final crafting task: chest provides glass, orchid provides dye ingredient.
task_text: Explore the acacia outpost: find the acacia logs ahead, locate the white and red wool displays to the right, harvest the potted blue orchid from the shelf near the wool, enter the stone workshop to the left to open the chest and collect glass, find the TNT block inside, mine the black stained glass window, then use the crafting table to craft light blue stained glass. Hint: craft the blue orchid into light blue dye first, then combine 8 glass with 1 light blue dye.

Interior contains: chest(-7,1,9), TNT(-8,1,9), crafting table(-5,1,7), sign(-5,1,8), black glass(-9,2,7-8).
